scope: Warm-cache headless real CLI commands against a controlled local model fixture; identical primary content/tools, no paid model calls. Fresh workspace/session for each run; isolated HOME retained per client after one unmeasured warmup. Default client features/session saving enabled.

method.memory: Separate pass: five repetitions per case/client, summed process-tree PSS/RSS sampled every5ms. Memory sampling disabled for reported timing/CPU trials. Brief memory peaks may be missed.
method.cpu: wait4 user+system CPU for launched CLI, including waited descendants and launcher.
method.client_tool_gap: Sum response-completely-sent to next primary request-received across five tool steps; includes tool execution, history/session handling and HTTP.
method.first_visible: Time from first server SSE body write until BENCH_ marker observed on stdout; default headless text mode.
method.first_response_to_exit: Includes controlled stream delays, subsequent fixture preparation, auxiliary model calls, session saving and shutdown.
limitations: Python fixture/sampling overhead and OS scheduling affect small timings.
Different feature sets and default prompts; this is workload equivalence, not full feature parity.
No terminal TUI rendering, real model inference, WAN latency, long conversations or production load measured.
TLS uses each client negotiated cipher, reported per case.
Original JavaScript has extra default functionality, including a managed-memory model call during exit; fixture returns a minimal answer for this auxiliary call.
Default headless text output is used; original JavaScript explicit partial stream-json mode is measured separately in javascript-streaming-mode.json.

memory_pass.method: Peak summed process-tree PSS/RSS sampled every5ms; PSS avoids double counting shared pages. Very brief peaks may be missed.

versions.assembly: qwen-x86 0.1.0 — static Linux x86-64 assembly; no libc or TLS library

release_scope: Historical baseline before TCP_NODELAY/pidfd wait optimization; current tool-gap comparison is wait-optimization.json.
